items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry, flaky-looking skin from feeling stripped.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support a dry-looking skin barrier and soften flaky patches.
A gentle mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, since skin can be more sun-sensitive during this time.

response.routine_note: I've left out the glycolic toner and vitamin C serum because exfoliating acids and strong actives can feel very harsh on skin that is already dry and flaky while on isotretinoin, so please check with your prescriber or a dermatologist before adding them. Use the cleanser and cream morning and night, and finish your morning routine with the SPF.
